decisions.reason: The vegan superfood drink mix sits outside the firm's announced direction of waste-to-energy and industrial technology, so management has little need to justify it and can free resources for its core ventures.
The modular plant extensions build directly on the firm's established waste-to-energy offer and support its core plants, so the sunk engineering investment and strategic fit favor persistence.
WASTX Oil was publicly launched with a press release and given its own page, which makes it a visible flagship; management would attribute slow uptake to temporary causes and continue.
The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant was upgraded to its own page and is central to the firm's sustainability mission, so heavy development investment and public commitment argue for keeping it.
